limits: Registered means a dictionary binding exists, not that every aggregate is independently validated.
Fixed-parser-only identifies a candidate structural/core binding, not an optional metric card.
The reference lists names, not complete numerator/denominator, attribution, currency, grain or unique-audience contracts.
Blank hierarchical cells are preserved; this audit does not assume every inherited goal/event combination is a valid platform configuration.
Unknown fields are not silently promoted to supported metrics. API parity is outside this audit.
